profile.name: Silvio Christian Joe
profile.specialization: Natural Language Processing (NLP) & Tabular Data Analysis
profile.summary: I am a 5th-semester Informatics Engineering undergraduate driven by curiosity to turn raw data into meaningful stories. I specialize in mining insights from structured numbers (Tabular) and unstructured language (NLP). My approach goes beyond algorithms; I focus on rigorous preprocessing, handling class imbalances (SMOTE/SMOTENC), and building end-to-end solutions from training to API deployment.
profile.quote: Data is the new oil, but it’s useless without the engine to refine it.

projects.name: DocuTalk-AI (Smart RAG)
projects.description: An intelligent document assistant using Agentic Workflow (ReAct). It autonomously decides between retrieving information from uploaded documents (PDF, CSV, TXT, MD) or performing a Web Search. Features incremental indexing for cost efficiency and strict language control.

projects.name: Stuntify API
projects.description: A high-performance inference engine serving real-time stunting predictions. Designed with strict Type Coercion, multi-artifact orchestration, and interactive Swagger documentation.

projects.name: Insightify API
projects.description: A dual-lingual (English & Indonesian) NLP microservice for sentiment analysis. Supports batch processing (Excel/CSV) and N-Gram keyword extraction.

projects.name: DocuChat AI (Long Context)
projects.description: An alternative to RAG that analyzes entire PDFs without chunking by leveraging Gemini's massive context window. Features real-time token monitoring.

projects.name: Diabetes Prediction (Robust)
projects.description: A best-practice implementation of a predictive model ensuring NO data leakage by applying Scaling & SMOTE techniques specifically *after* data splitting.

projects.name: AI Recipe Generator
projects.description: An agentic app that orchestrates a cooking assistant using LangChain ReAct Agents. It can detect ingredients from images (Vision) and generate recipes with conversation memory.

projects.name: Stunting Prediction & Analysis
projects.description: Developed a robust machine learning model to predict stunting risks. Handled categorical imbalance using SMOTENC and utilized Pruned Tree visualization for model interpretability.

projects.name: Conversational AI Companion
projects.description: Designed an interactive conversational agent leveraging NLP techniques to simulate empathetic, human-like dialogue and context-aware responses.
